settings.title: Size Guide
settings.subtitle: Two sizes, and at the 7.5 overlap the width of your foot decides — here's how to find yours.
settings.snug_colors_note: Dark Grey, Hot Coral, and Blue run slightly snugger. Black and Light Grey are the most forgiving, especially for wider feet.
settings.light_grey_note: Black and Light Grey offer a slightly more relaxed fit. True to size for most customers.
settings.cta_note: Still unsure? Contact us with your usual shoe size and we'll tell you which to take.

settings.title: Between sizes? Width decides.
settings.description: 7.5 sits in both rows on purpose — don't just round up. A wide foot at 7 or 7.5 should size up to Large. A narrow foot at 7.5 or 8 should size down to Medium. At 8.5 and above, stay in Large — you need the length, whatever your width.

settings.title: Narrow feet
settings.description: Take the Medium if you're a narrow 7.5 or 8, and consider Dark Grey, Hot Coral, or Blue — they run snugger. A thin toeless or individual-toe sock underneath also adds security without affecting grip.

settings.title: How they should feel
settings.description: Secure — not pinching, and not sliding around on your foot. The material stretches and conforms to your foot, so depending on your foot shape that can feel close or more relaxed. There's no break-in period: how they feel on day one is how they feel.

settings.title: How to place them
settings.description: The ball of your foot sits where your foot meets your toes. Gently tug the top edge at the ankle to seat them correctly.
